info.title: Core
info.description: All included utility endpoints for Basiq partners

get.description: Returns a paginated list of previously generated insights for the specified user. Supports filtering by creation date and insight type. Maximum 20 insights per page.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter parameter supporting multiple filter fields separated by commas. Supported fields: 'created' (date in YYYY-MM-DD format) and 'insightType' (account, balance, identity). Operators: gteq (>=), lteq (<=), gt (>), lt (<), eq (=), bt (between two dates). Examples: 'created.gteq('2025-06-16')', 'created.bt('2025-08-25','2025-09-02')', 'insightType.eq('account')', 'created.bt('2025-06-01','2025-08-30'),insightType.eq('balance')'

200.description: Successful response with list of insights

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid filter parameters or request content

data.title: Invalid request content
data.detail: Invalid filter param: invalid date format for 'created' (expected YYYY-MM-DD): not-a-date

data.title: Invalid request content
data.detail: Invalid filter param: invalid dates for 'created': 'to date' is before 'from date'
